interface: CodingModelProvider (same as SolarProvider): generate(ModelRequest, logical_request_id, org_id)->(ModelResponse, ModelCallRecord)

family_rules.gpt5.6: reasoning.effort set; NO temperature; one response; no continuation; no repair; max_output_tokens=frozen R11 budget
family_rules.gpt4o: temperature=0; NO reasoning; one response; no repair; same budget

retry_policy: retry 429/5xx/transport (bounded); NO retry on ordinary 4xx; AuthError/InvalidRequest terminal
accounting: ModelCallRecord per outcome: input/cached_input/output/reasoning/total tokens, latency, retries, finish_reason, redaction, final_status
credential: key only via secret provider (OPENAI_API_KEY); never in exceptions/logs/headers persisted; redaction.sanitize on output
sdk_reference: official openai Python SDK contract (Responses API); exact installed version + wheel hashes to be pinned in CI at first live run
prompt_rule: identical system+task+memory+extraction+grader+budget across readers; provider-specific prompt rewriting PROHIBITED
